Xander Mobus is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Mobus was born on July 8, 1992 in , and is a voice actor based in . Mobus first worked on Pokémon voicing Steven Stone in Pokémon Masters EX. When Pokémon started being dubbed in Los Angeles, Mobus joined where he gained his most notable role of Goh's father Walker.
